title: Pure Witchcrafter
summary: Witchcrafter cards, including the 2026 Endymion maids that always count as Witchcrafter, with generic Links and staples. Witchcrafter monsters tribute themselves on either Main Phase and discard a Spell to summon a different Witchcrafter from the Deck. Every Witchcrafter Spell returns to the hand in the End Phase while you control a Witchcrafter, so the discards come back. Verre, the Maid of Endymion, the newest card, summons itself after a Spell resolves and searches a Witchcrafter Spell/Trap. Genni, the Maid of Endymion summons itself next to a Spellcaster and banishes one to pull a Witchcrafter from the Deck. Witchcrafter Haine destroys a face-up card, and Madame Verre negates their whole board. Witchcrafter Confusion Confession makes Witchcrafter Vice-Madame, which destroys, summons or recovers whenever a Spell or Spellcaster effect activates. The OCG-only Witchcrafter cards stay out.
